title: Minix 1.7.5 (classic Tanenbaum Unix)
notes: BSD-3 combo floppy, run unmodified. Boots to the Minix boot monitor on PCXT8086 (needs a PC/AT BIOS ROM via romBytes). The monitor then waits for '=' to launch the kernel; driving that keystroke (8255 port 60h scancode + IRQ1) is a tracked follow-up, so this manifest pins the monitor. Use 1.7, not 2.0.4 (2.0.4 wants a 286 — that's the 286 tier).
